Doses such as this have been known to cause hospitalizations and/or deaths. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
Klonopin is a wonder drug just like any other benzo. I'm 22 years old and have been on it since I was 16.  I'm severely addicted to this drug. I have to take 6 mg a day just not to be an anxiety wreck or in withdrawl.  It still relieves my anxiety, but I need 10mg to feel anything and 20mg (10 2mg pills) to catch a mild buzz for a few hours.  I can't get off 8mg a day.I've tried,and tried. I'm stuck with it, but I need it for panic disorder.  By the way, 8mg a day is from a crooked doc. I wanted it and got what I deserved.
